description: This file defines a Settings Store class for managing user preferences and application settings in the Notesnook project, including methods for updating settings, toggling features, and synchronizing with external components.

classes.name: SettingStore
classes.description: A class extending BaseStore to manage application settings, including user preferences, UI options, and integration states, with methods to update and toggle various settings.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the store state with current settings from database and external integrations.

methods.name: setDateFormat
methods.description: Sets the date format in settings and updates the database.

methods.name: setTimeFormat
methods.description: Sets the time format in settings and updates the database.

methods.name: setDayFormat
methods.description: Sets the day format in settings and updates the database.

methods.name: setWeekFormat
methods.description: Sets the week format in settings and updates the database.

methods.name: setTitleFormat
methods.description: Sets the title format in settings and updates the database.

methods.name: setTrashCleanupInterval
methods.description: Sets the trash cleanup interval in settings and updates the database.

methods.name: setZoomFactor
methods.description: Updates the zoom factor in the application and store.

methods.name: setProxyRules
methods.description: Updates the proxy rules in the application and store.

methods.name: setEncryptBackups
methods.description: Enables or disables backup encryption and updates the configuration.

methods.name: setHomepage
methods.description: Sets the homepage configuration.

methods.name: setDefaultSidebarTab
methods.description: Sets the default sidebar tab in user preferences.

methods.name: setImageCompression
methods.description: Sets the image compression option.

methods.name: setDesktopIntegration
methods.description: Updates desktop integration settings.

methods.name: setNotificationSettings
methods.description: Updates notification preferences.

methods.name: toggleEncryptBackups
methods.description: Toggles the backup encryption setting.

methods.name: setBackupReminderOffset
methods.description: Sets the backup reminder offset.

methods.name: setFullBackupReminderOffset
methods.description: Sets the full backup reminder offset.

methods.name: setBackupStorageLocation
methods.description: Sets the backup storage location.

methods.name: toggleDoubleSpacedParagraphs
methods.description: Toggles the double-spaced paragraphs setting.

methods.name: toggleMarkdownShortcuts
methods.description: Toggles markdown shortcuts.

methods.name: toggleFontLigatures
methods.description: Toggles font ligatures.

methods.name: togglePrivacyMode
methods.description: Toggles privacy mode and updates external component.

methods.name: toggleCustomDns
methods.description: Toggles custom DNS setting and updates external component.

methods.name: toggleHideTitle
methods.description: Toggles hiding note titles.

methods.name: toggleAutoUpdates
methods.description: Toggles automatic updates.

methods.name: toggleFullOfflineMode
methods.description: Enables or disables full offline mode.

methods.name: setServerUrls
methods.description: Updates server URLs configuration.

methods.name: toggleInbox
methods.description: Enables or disables inbox feature, managing API keys and user confirmation.
